title: What does one and a quarter hours of internet time cost?
description: One hour of internet time costs a fixed amount, and the video finds the cost of one and a quarter hours by changing the mixed fraction into a fraction first and then multiplying. Keeko then raises a hand with the doubt that the quarter can be added to the rupees.
teaching_notes: One idea: change a mixed fraction into a fraction first, then multiply it by the whole number. Watch for students who attach the fraction part of the time to the amount of money.

source: 1 hour of internet time costs ₹8. How much will 1 1/4 hours of internet time cost?
video_script.why: The child can multiply a fraction by a whole number and now meets a time that is a mixed fraction, which must be changed to a fraction before multiplying.
video_script.substitution: One and a quarter hours is five quarters of an hour, and each quarter of an hour costs two rupees.
video_script.anchor: One hour of internet time costs eight rupees: what do one and a quarter hours cost?
video_script.wrong_move: adds the quarter of the time to the eight rupees and gets eight and a quarter rupees, although a quarter of an hour costs two rupees
video_script.payoff_line: It costs ten rupees for one and a quarter hours of internet time
video_script.fraction_reading: one and a quarter, five quarters
video_script.design: One idea: change the mixed fraction into a fraction, then multiply. One strip for one hour, cut into four quarters, is the anchor and stays all video; the working band builds in the idea part.

beats.on_screen: small title card From your book; a clock showing 1 hour beside a label ₹8; a clock showing 1 1/4 hours with a question mark

marks.scene: the small title card From your book appears
marks.cost: the one hour clock and the label of eight rupees appear
marks.ask: the clock for one and a quarter hours and a question mark appear

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book about internet time.
<bookmark mark='cost'/>One hour of internet time costs eight rupees.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>How much will one and a quarter hours of internet time cost?

beats.on_screen: the question stays on the board; Keeko sits at the corner of the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: a strip for one hour labelled ₹8; the strip is cut into four equal quarters; one whole strip and one more quarter are set side by side

marks.hour: the strip for one hour appears with its cost
marks.cut: the strip is cut into four equal quarters
marks.five: one whole strip and one more quarter are set side by side

narration: <bookmark mark='hour'/>One hour of internet time is a strip, and it costs eight rupees.
<bookmark mark='cut'/>Cut the strip into four equal quarters.
<bookmark mark='five'/>One and a quarter hours is the whole strip and one more quarter. That is five quarters of an hour.

marks.given: the given line is written in the working band

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, one hour of internet time costs eight rupees.

marks.find: the find line is written under the given line

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the cost of one and a quarter hours.
<bookmark mark='change'/>Step one, change the mixed fraction into a fraction.
One and a quarter is four quarters and one more quarter, which is five quarters of an hour.
<bookmark mark='cost'/>Step two, the cost of five quarters of an hour is five quarters of eight rupees.
We write five quarters times eight.

marks.div: 8 ÷ 4 = 2 is shown as the cost of one quarter hour

narration: <bookmark mark='div'/>Step three, take the eight and divide it by four.
Eight divided by four is two rupees, the cost of one quarter of an hour.
<bookmark mark='mult'/>The cost is then five times two.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Five times two is ten.
It costs ten rupees for one and a quarter hours of internet time.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the answer
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: ₹8 1/4 is written and crossed out; a note shows one quarter hour = ₹2, not ₹1/4; the strip of four quarters is shown again

marks.fix: the note one quarter hour = ₹2 appears and the line is crossed out
marks.rule: the mixed fraction 1 1/4 turns into 5/4 once more

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the answer is eight and a quarter rupees.
Keeko added the quarter to the eight rupees.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>But a quarter of an hour costs two rupees, and not a quarter of a rupee.
The quarter belongs to the hours, and not to the rupees.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>Change the mixed fraction into a fraction first, then multiply.
